comparison_projection.units: meters; project approximate local conversion, not surveyed CRS

method: Project outer way nodes to campus-local XY; apply sequential 0.3 m importer point filter; compare bottom-ring source mesh vertices with filtered source vertices using symmetric nearest-vertex distance. This verifies consistency with the original OSM import only; it is not independent spatial accuracy or a structural wall-footprint certification.
height_status: Unverified: OSM feature has neither height nor building:levels tags; source mesh retains 16 m original massing.
position_status: Original project-local coordinates retained; approximate map projection and original OSM snapshot consistency do not constitute independent location verification.
